name: Contempora Fabrics Inc
old_description: Founded in 1972, Contempora Fabrics is an employee owned circular knit company based in Lumberton, NC.  Starting as a contract knitter, Contempora has evolved into one of the premier knit fabric manufacturers in the US.  With over 200 machines and a capacity of 2 million pounds per month, Contempora has continued to expand to meet the needs of our customers.
about:
Contempora Fabrics, founded in 1972 by Lacy C. Nance, is an employee-owned circular knit manufacturer based in Lumberton, North Carolina. The company began as a contract knitter producing fine gauge interlock and single knit fabrics, and transitioned to full employee ownership through an ESOP in 1988.

Today the company operates 175 circular knitting machines in a 150,000-square-foot facility on 29 acres, with a monthly capacity of 2 million pounds of fabric. It offers both greige and finished fabrics, supported by an in-house research and development team that provides fabric analysis and works with the latest fiber technologies. The lint-controlled, humidity-defined manufacturing environment allows simultaneous processing of all fiber types.

Contempora serves brands, retailers, and manufacturers across performance and activewear, athletic and team apparel, fashion and formal wear, casual and career wear, intimate apparel and shapewear, and swimwear and beachwear. Its client base includes companies such as Boombah, and the staff has extensive experience handling USMCA and CAFTA-DR shipping requirements for weekly container shipments to Central America.

The company emphasizes its ESOP culture as a driver of quality and on-time delivery, alongside sustainability initiatives that have reduced energy consumption through lighting upgrades and recycling of byproducts such as cardboard tubes, scrap yarn, and plastic. Competitive pricing and short lead times are cited as daily commitments.
